neighbours.label: ' turning' in 'turning point', ' much' before a comparative and ' built' in 'built-in' (first word of a fixed pre-noun modifier after 'a')
fire: The invention of printing was a turning point in European history.
The new engine runs at a much higher temperature.
For the team, that defeat became a turning point.
Prices are rising at a much quicker pace this year.
The laptop has a built-in camera and microphone.
Her first novel marked a turning point in her career.
The river is a much safer place to swim now.
The oven comes with a built-in timer.
quiet: The invention of printing changed European history for good.
The new engine runs at a far higher temperature.
For the team, that defeat was the start of a decline.
Prices are rising at a quicker pace this year.
The laptop has an extra camera and microphone.
She kept turning the pages of her first novel.
The river is a far safer place to swim now.
The oven comes with a separate timer.

notes: Card: ' much' x11 ' turning' x7 ' built' x3. Probe: 'a turning point' 0.90, 'a much faster' 0.93, 'built-in' 0.41; 'turning the pages' 0.05, 'far worse' 0.07. Kept as a list: the shared pattern is unclear.
